    "source0": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/test_0.csv",
    "source1": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/test_1.csv",
    "source2": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/test_2.csv",
    "source3": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/test_3.csv",
    "source4": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/test_4.csv",
    "source5": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/test_5.csv",
    "source6": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/test_6.csv",
    "source7": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/test_7.csv",
    "source8": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/test_8.csv",
    "source9": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/test_9.csv",
}

# Step 1: Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source0"], index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source1"], index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source2"], index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source3"], index_col=0)
df4 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source4"], index_col=0)
df5 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source5"], index_col=0)
df6 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source6"], index_col=0)
df7 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source7"], index_col=0)
df8 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source8"], index_col=0)
df9 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source9"], index_col=0)

# Step 2: Union dimension tables (same schema)
# Source0, Source2, Source6, Source7 have the same schema:
# ['CANCELED', 'ROW_WID', 'ACCNT_LOC', 'ARPU', 'SES', 'HOME_PASSED', 'CUST_SINCE_DT',
#  'MONTHS_AGE', 'CANCEL_DT', 'CITY', 'POP']
df_dim = pd.concat([df0, df2, df6, df7], ignore_index=True)

# Step 3: Aggregate aspect tables on ROW_WID to avoid duplicates before join
def aggregate_sum_on_row_wid(df, value_col):
    return df.groupby("ROW_WID", as_index=False)[value_col].sum()

df1_agg = aggregate_sum_on_row_wid(df1, "KEYWORDS_NUM")
df3_agg = aggregate_sum_on_row_wid(df3, "VISITS_NUM")
df4_agg = aggregate_sum_on_row_wid(df4, "COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM")
df5_agg = aggregate_sum_on_row_wid(df5, "TECHSUPPORT_NUM")
df8_agg = aggregate_sum_on_row_wid(df8, "INBOUND_CALLS_NUM")
df9_agg = aggregate_sum_on_row_wid(df9, "INTERACTIONS_NUM")

# Step 4: Inner join all aspect tables with dimension table on ROW_WID
df_merged = df_dim.merge(df1_agg, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")
df_merged = df_merged.merge(df3_agg, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")
df_merged = df_merged.merge(df4_agg, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")
df_merged = df_merged.merge(df5_agg, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")
df_merged = df_merged.merge(df8_agg, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")
df_merged = df_merged.merge(df9_agg, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Step 5: Fill NaN values in numeric columns with 0 (should be minimal due to inner join)
numeric_cols = [
    "KEYWORDS_NUM",
    "VISITS_NUM",
    "COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM",
    "TECHSUPPORT_NUM",
    "INBOUND_CALLS_NUM",
    "INTERACTIONS_NUM",
]

df_merged[numeric_cols] = df_merged[numeric_cols].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Step 6: Cast columns to target schema types
df_merged["CANCELED"] = df_merged["CANCELED"].astype(int)
df_merged["ROW_WID"] = df_merged["ROW_WID"].astype(int)
df_merged["ACCNT_LOC"] = df_merged["ACCNT_LOC"].astype(int)
df_merged["ARPU"] = df_merged["ARPU"].astype(float)
df_merged["SES"] = df_merged["SES"].astype(str)
df_merged["HOME_PASSED"] = df_merged["HOME_PASSED"].astype(int)
df_merged["CUST_SINCE_DT"] = df_merged["CUST_SINCE_DT"].astype(str)
df_merged["MONTHS_AGE"] = df_merged["MONTHS_AGE"].astype(float)
# CANCEL_DT can have NaN, convert to string with NaN replaced by empty string
df_merged["CANCEL_DT"] = df_merged["CANCEL_DT"].fillna("").astype(str)
df_merged["CITY"] = df_merged["CITY"].astype(str)
df_merged["POP"] = df_merged["POP"].astype(str)

# Step 7: Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    "CANCELED",
    "ROW_WID",
    "ACCNT_LOC",
    "ARPU",
    "SES",
    "HOME_PASSED",
    "CUST_SINCE_DT",
    "MONTHS_AGE",
    "CANCEL_DT",
    "CITY",
    "POP",
    "COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM",
    "INBOUND_CALLS_NUM",
    "KEYWORDS_NUM",
    "VISITS_NUM",
    "TECHSUPPORT_NUM",
    "INTERACTIONS_NUM",
]

df_final = df_merged[target_columns]

# Step 8: Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
